summary: Tillamook County tower: pole platform built 1933, replaced 1937 by a 30-foot pole tower with cab, removed 1948; registers say it is gone, no present-day description found.

facts.design: pole platform tower (1933), replaced in 1937 by a 30-foot pole tower with a live-in cab
facts.status_note: Removed in 1948 per the register and lookout history; a firelookout.com listing says destroyed
facts.agency: NW Oregon FPA (register); Oregon Department of Forestry (lookout history)

events.note: Pole platform tower constructed; the lookout history describes it as a pole tower with open platform
Panorama photographs taken (register caption dates them 9-27-36)
Replaced by a 30-foot pole tower with live-in cab
Removed (register and lookout history); firelookout.com says destroyed

evidence.supports: pole platform tower 1933, replaced 1937 with 30-foot pole live-in tower
evidence.quote: In 1933 a pole platform tower was constructed, which was replaced in 1937 with a 30' pole live-in tower.

evidence.supports: 1933 pole tower with open platform as the lookout structure

evidence.supports: administered by the Oregon Department of Forestry in the lookout history

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the lookout history say removed in 1948; firelookout.com says destroyed. The story gives both, and the register's removed is the primary date.
The register lists NW Oregon FPA; the lookout history lists the Oregon Department of Forestry. The story reports both, without choosing.

notes_for_editor: A Living New Deal page on the Camp Reehers fire towers in Tillamook State Forest returned HTTP 403 and was not read; it may mention this site. No staffing or fire information found for Gauldy Mountain, so none is given. The register's panorama and 2009 site photo have no image URLs in the cached text, so no photos are added. Access level not set: no source says whether the site is open.
